title: Gap analysis samples and analytics: secrets, keys, isolation, vulnerabilities, inventory, endpoints and TLS
source_system: Secret scanning; key service; CI test reports; scanners; cloud inventory; EDR and device management; non-production data scan; bug bounty platform; TLS scanner
what_it_shows: Secret scanning over about 3,800 repositories plus the AQ-01 repositories: 212 live secrets in 2026 H1; 25 of about 9,800 tenant keys plus service keys: 4 without automatic rotation; 40 of 412 services: 3 without isolation tests; 60 of 2,410 critical and high findings on OCP images (2026 H1): 8 past the 15-day SLA; 60 of about 86,000 OCP resources traced: 4 untagged; EDR and device analytics over about 14,500 endpoints: 142 without EDR, all in a 30-day remediation queue; data scan of 118 non-production accounts: no production data found; 25 of 186 valid bug bounty reports (2026 H1): 0 exceptions; external TLS scan of OCP endpoints: TLS 1.2 or higher

title: Gap analysis analytics: tenant deletion, snapshot retention and free-text case sample
source_system: Offboarding job logs; billing terminated-tenant list; Data Cloud snapshots; case data (with customer consent)
what_it_shows: 412 OCP tenants terminated 2025-07-01 to 2026-06-30: 23 still present 41 to 212 days after termination; 138 Data Cloud tenants terminated in 12 months: 96 still present in snapshots after 90 days; 2,000 cases from 20 health care tenants (random, with customer consent): 9 with health information in free text
